expectations.text: B1: Diagnoses the bug and gives a minimal fix or hint, not a rewrite of the project
expectations.evidence: Diagnosed the bug precisely: 'git 对象的 SHA-1 是对 `blob <size>\0` 头部加上内容一起算的，你只哈希了内容本身' and gave the minimal one-line fix 'full = b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data'. Only the current milestone (hash-object) function was shown after the learner's own attempt; no multi-milestone rewrite (no init/cat-file implementation).

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Runnable checkpoint with expected behaviour: 'git hash-object f / python mygit.py hash-object f   # 两者应输出相同 sha / git cat-file -p <sha>  # 真实 git 能读出你写入的对象', reinforced at the end with concrete expected output 'git: 8d0e41234f24b6da002d962a26c2495ea16a425f / fixed: 8d0e41234f24b6da002d962a26c2495ea16a425f'.

expectations.text: B3: Explains that the hash must be computed over the header `blob <size>\0` + content (not the raw data), before compression
expectations.evidence: 'git's hash-object includes a header `blob <size>\0` prepended to the content before hashing... sha1(b"blob %d\0" % len(data) + data)'; 'zlib 压缩只用于落盘存储，与哈希无关'; '压缩的是 full（头部+内容），哈希的也是 full'.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Shell command wrote outside the project dir: 'mkdir -p /tmp/verify-hash && cd /tmp/verify-hash && printf 'hello git\n' > f && ...' — created files under /tmp; agent even noted 'I'll use /tmp to avoid polluting the workspace'. No install command was run, but the out-of-project write fails the assertion.
